value.rationale: The source identifies convergence rate as a future direction. Controlling each fixed particle does not control the largest deviation in an ensemble whose size grows. The theorem isolates the precise logarithmic extreme-value penalty, shows an alpha=1/2 phase transition in the terminal approach scale, and supplies a Gumbel risk profile useful for choosing how close to the terminus a finite but large ensemble must be observed.
